name: Sandisk Corporation

sections.title: Quarterly revenue
sections.callout: Outlook: Sandisk guided Q1 FY2027 revenue to $10.3B–$10.8B with a GAAP gross margin of 83.0%–84.9%.

footnotes: Fiscal 2026 had 53 weeks (ended Jul 3, 2026); fiscal 2025 had 52 weeks (ended Jun 27, 2025). Fiscal 2025 included a $1,830M goodwill impairment.
Other operating items include employee termination and other costs. Free cash flow as reported by Sandisk: operating cash flow − purchases of property, plant & equipment.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Sandisk's revenue jumped 175% to $20.2B in fiscal 2026 (53 weeks ended July 3, 2026) on surging demand for flash memory. Datacenter revenue rose to $5.2B from $1.0B, and Edge revenue nearly tripled to $12.2B. Gross margin climbed to 71.5% from 30.1%.

Operating income was $12.4B, compared with a $1.4B loss a year earlier that included a $1.8B goodwill impairment. Net income was $11.4B, or $73.76 per diluted share. Free cash flow reached $11.5B, and Sandisk repaid all of its $1.8B of debt.
highlights: Q4 FY2026 revenue reached a record $9.0B, 4.7 times the year-ago quarter.
Datacenter grew 5.4 times to $5.2B, a quarter of revenue.
Operating expenses rose only modestly, so operating margin reached 61.2%.
Cash rose to $4.8B with no debt.
watch: Results depend heavily on flash memory pricing, which is cyclical.
The Q1 FY2027 outlook of $10.3B–$10.8B implies another sharp step up, raising the bar for future quarters.
Fiscal 2026 had one more week than fiscal 2025, which flatters the year-over-year comparison slightly.
